jobs.title: Video Editor Intern
jobs.description:
Video Editor Intern – Remote

Company:VP NEXUES Private Limited

Location: Tamil Nadu, India

Work Mode: Remote

Job Type: Internship

Duration: 6 Months

Experience Level: Fresher

Industry: Import, Export \& Agricultural Supply Chain

About VP NEXUES Private Limited

VP NEXUES Private Limited connects agricultural producers and suppliers with domestic and international markets. We use digital platforms and content to communicate our business, products, and brand.

Job Description

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented Video Editor Intern to help produce engaging video content for digital platforms. The selected candidate will support video editing, visual storytelling, and content preparation for company marketing and promotional activities.

Roles and Responsibilities

\- Edit and assemble video clips for social media and digital marketing.

\- Create short\-form videos, reels, and promotional content.

\- Add transitions, text, subtitles, background music, and visual effects where appropriate.

\- Adjust video timing, audio levels, and basic colour settings.

\- Prepare videos in suitable formats and aspect ratios for different platforms.

\- Coordinate with the marketing team to understand content requirements.

\- Follow brand guidelines and incorporate feedback into revisions.

\- Organize video files and maintain project folders.

\- Meet assigned deadlines and provide regular progress updates.

Eligibility and Skills

\- Students and freshers interested in video editing may apply.

\- Basic knowledge of video editing software such as CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar tools.

\- Understanding of short\-form video formats and social media content.

\- Creativity, attention to detail, and visual storytelling skills.

\- Willingness to learn and work on feedback.

\- A portfolio or sample editing work is preferred, but not mandatory.

Working Hours and Weekly Off

\- Working Days:Monday to Friday (5 days per week).

\- Working Hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST.

\- Weekly Off:Saturday and Sunday.

\- Work Mode: Remote within Tamil Nadu.

Interns are expected to attend scheduled meetings, communicate progress, and complete assigned tasks during working hours.

Internship Details

\- Duration: 6 months.

\- Training and Guidance: Guidance will be provided for assigned tasks and learning activities..

\- Selection Process: Resume screening, interview, and a review of portfolio or sample editing work where available.

Learning Opportunities

Selected candidates will gain practical exposure to video production workflows, social media content creation, editing techniques, brand communication, and digital marketing support.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may submit their updated resume and, if available, portfolio or video\-editing samples through the application platform. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Equal Opportunity Statement: Applications are welcome from eligible candidates who meet the stated requirements. Selection will be based on relevant skills, creativity, and suitability for the internship.

jobs.title: Biomedical Technician
jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled and responsible **Treatment Technician** to perform treatments using various machines and equipment as per the prescribed treatment protocols. The technician will be responsible for operating equipment safely, assisting clients/patients during treatments, maintaining treatment standards, and ensuring proper care and hygiene.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform treatments using the designated machines and equipment according to established protocols.
* Understand and operate treatment machines safely and effectively.
* Prepare the machine, treatment room, and required materials before each session.
* Explain the basic treatment procedure to clients/patients and provide appropriate instructions before and after treatment.
* Follow treatment settings, duration, intensity, and procedures as instructed by the doctor/therapist/supervisor.
* Monitor the client/patient during the treatment and immediately report any discomfort, adverse reaction, or unusual response.
* Maintain proper hygiene, cleanliness, and sanitation of treatment areas and equipment.
* Clean, disinfect, and safely store machines and accessories after use.
* Check machines regularly and report any malfunction, damage, or maintenance requirement.
* Maintain accurate treatment records, including treatment performed, machine/settings used, and session details.
* Follow all company safety procedures, treatment protocols, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure proper handling and care of all treatment equipment.
